comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: Over 1/4 of the economy relies on remittances from men working abroad, while the women left behind carry the weight of the farms and families, yet their labor is barely officially "counted". The video title truly reflects a heartbreaking but fiercely resilient reality of Nepali women. An outstanding documentary! 🇳🇵💪

replies.author: @reallifeincountries
replies.text: "Thank you for such an insightful and thoughtful summary! 🇳🇵 💪 The resilience of these women while sustaining their communities is truly remarkable."
